Prompt library

Chinese prompt templates for high-frequency scenarios, one-tap copy

This library collects Chinese prompt templates for writing, translation, coding, summarization, learning and office scenarios. Tap "Copy", paste into any AI chat tool, and replace the [bracketed placeholders] with your content. The prompt bodies are deliberately kept in Chinese — they are written for Chinese-language AI tools and Chinese output; the titles and scenario labels below are translated for browsing. What makes a good prompt: role + task + constraints + output format.
